prompts.question: Is the lead designer or firm officially registered as a Registered Interior Designer (IDr) or Interior Design Consultancy Practice under the Architects Act 1967?
prompts.why_it_matters: Under the Architects Act 1967, using the title 'Interior Designer' or offering professional interior design services without LAM registration is an illegal offense carrying statutory penalties.

source.name: Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia (Board of Architects Malaysia)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the LAM Public Search Register under 'Interior Designer' or 'Interior Design Practice' for {company} or principal name
prompts.found_when: The firm markets itself as an 'Interior Designer' or uses 'IDr' title but neither firm nor lead partner is registered on the LAM roll
prompts.not_found_when: The designer or practice is confirmed with an active LAM registration number
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The LAM portal search system is offline

tested.result: Principal architectural and design credentials verified compliant with design-build standards
Design consultancies properly designated as commercial interior design and build
Space planning studio operating within permitted renovation and interior decoration scopes
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia (Board of Architects Malaysia)

prompts.question: Does the interior design firm hold an active CIDB Contractor Registration Certificate (Grade G1–G7 with category B04/B28) for executing interior fit-out and renovation works?
prompts.why_it_matters: Executing commercial or residential construction/renovation contracts in Malaysia without CIDB registration violates Act 520 and subjects the firm to stop-work orders and hefty fines.
prompts.how_to_query: Search CIDB CIMS contractor directory using company name or SSM number to check registration validity and grade (G1 to G7)
prompts.found_when: The firm accepts renovation contracts but lacks active CIDB contractor registration or required building specialization code
prompts.not_found_when: Firm holds active CIDB certificate with appropriate grade covering contract sum
prompts.couldnt_check_when: CIDB CIMS system is undergoing server maintenance

tested.result: Holds active CIDB Grade G7 registration for large-scale interior fit-outs
Verified CIDB contractor registration covering commercial fit-out works
Renovation subcontracting partners hold valid CIDB registrations
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Construction Industry Development Board Malaysia (CIDB)

prompts.question: Does the interior designer or practice hold verified Corporate Member or Corporate Practice status with the Malaysian Institute of Interior Designers (MIID)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely displaying the MIID badge or claiming corporate practice standing damages client trust and breaches intellectual property agreements with the national institute.
prompts.how_to_query: Check the MIID Member Directory on miid.org.my for {company} or practitioner name
prompts.found_when: The website displays MIID corporate badges but the firm or practitioner is absent from the MIID register
prompts.not_found_when: The firm or principal is verified as an active MIID Corporate Member or Practice
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The MIID directory is temporarily unreachable

tested.result: Design practice association credentials verified
Does not make deceptive claims regarding corporate MIID practice status
Professional memberships accurately cited in corporate profile
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Malaysian Institute of Interior Designers (MIID)

prompts.question: Can the national design awards (such as the MIID REKA Awards for Design Excellence) claimed in the firm's portfolio be verified against official competition records?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely claiming prestigious national design awards exposes the studio to public copyright challenges and disqualification from institutional developer tenders.
prompts.how_to_query: Query MIID REKA Awards published winners catalogs for project name, category, and designer
prompts.found_when: A portfolio project claims an official MIID REKA award that is absent from the official winners catalog
prompts.not_found_when: The project award title, category, and winning year match official MIID documentation
prompts.couldnt_check_when: MIID REKA archive files are inaccessible

tested.result: Project portfolio showcases legitimate industry design accolades
No fabricated REKA design award claims found on company site
Client testimonials and portfolio works independently verified
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for MIID REKA Awards

prompts.question: Do customer reviews and project completion complaints on leading Malaysian renovation portal Atap.co contradict the firm's claimed on-time delivery guarantees?
prompts.why_it_matters: Unresolved abandonment complaints or poor craftsmanship ratings on local renovation platforms drive away high-value homeowners and commercial fitout leads.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Atap.co firm profile for customer ratings, completed project badges, and negative dispute feedback
prompts.found_when: Multiple customer reviews report project delays, cost blowouts, or abandoned renovation works
prompts.not_found_when: Firm maintains strong rating and positive verified homeowner feedback with zero unresolved dispute reports
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Atap.co page is protected by bot detection

tested.result: Maintains strong project portfolio and positive client satisfaction on Atap.co
Positive reviews on commercial and residential renovations
Clean review profile without unresolved contractor complaints
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Atap.co Malaysia
